title: Ask by voice
prompt: Tap the mic and ask in your language, or type below
noMic: Voice isn't available in this browser. Type instead.

chat.demoNote: Demo answers. Connect the ClaimSathi backend for the AI assistant in your language.

errors.CHAT_RATE_LIMITED: Too many questions at once. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.CHAT_NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant isn't set up on the server yet (SARVAM_API_KEY is missing in backend/.env).
errors.CHAT_PROVIDER_AUTH: The assistant can't connect to its language service. The Sarvam API key may be wrong or revoked.
errors.CHAT_PROVIDER_CREDITS: The assistant's language service is out of credits.
errors.CHAT_TIMEOUT: The assistant took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.CHAT_UNREACHABLE: The server can't reach the assistant's language service right now.
errors.CHAT_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.CHAT_BAD_REQUEST: The assistant couldn't handle that message. Try asking it a different way.
errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Please sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.AUTH_INVALID: The server didn't accept your sign-in. Sign in again; if it keeps happening, check SUPABASE_URL in backend/.env.
errors.AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server can't check sign-ins yet: add SUPABASE_URL to backend/.env.
errors.AUTH_UNAVAILABLE: The server couldn't check your sign-in just now. Try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: That message couldn't be sent. Keep it under 1,000 characters.
errors.OFFLINE: You're offline. Connect to the internet and try again.
errors.BACKEND_DOWN: Can't reach the ClaimSathi server. Is the backend running?
